_comment: UNTESTED. Merge the "hooks" object into ~/.gemini/settings.json (Gemini CLI hooks: https://geminicli.com/docs/hooks/). Replace /ABS/PATH/TO. `--agent gemini` maps run_shell_command->Bash, write_file->Write and emits Gemini's {decision:deny,reason} format. Gemini timeouts are in milliseconds. Gemini has no per-turn Stop event wired here, so run `leavenotrace sweep` yourself (or from cron) for idle cleanup. Never exercised against a real Gemini CLI.
